scope: What a reality is and which kinds of reality are declared: an open, unranked kind list, presentations of those kinds, and classification kept separate from containment.
exclusions: No kind is ranked, ordered, or treated as more real than another.
No kind name is aliased to another; 'reality' is not silently 'base-reality'.
Whether a sempiternity contains base-reality or a base-reality contains a sempiternity is not decided.
Observability belongs to Hyperspace and order to Hypertime; neither is defined here.
No physical, cosmological, or simulation claim is established.
